response.justification: Far exceeds the 6+ years requirement with ~15 years of full-stack work across web, mobile, desktop and embedded systems, and recent, directly relevant experience in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS and Kubernetes. Current role at re:cinq explicitly includes AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which maps precisely to the 'AI agent development' requirement that most candidates lack. Strong testing/craftsmanship credentials (TDD, CI/CD, built a D test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium and testing workshops) fit the quality-focused responsibilities. Main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin and Python experience, plus a heavy investment in the niche D language, but the breadth of languages suggests these are quickly bridgeable.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js + React full-stack experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes and MongoDB
Hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work — a rare, directly matching requirement
Exceptional testing/craftsmanship track record (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, teaches workshops)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, Kotlin or Python experience listed
Relational DB depth unclear; recent work skews NoSQL/MongoDB
